children: Adicet Bio completed the last patient visit for prula-cel and expects topline SLE data in September 2026.
Completed last patient visit for Phase 1 prula-cel study in SLE with/without lupus nephritis; topline data expected Sept 2026.
Planned analysis includes 22 SLE patients with ≥6 months follow-up, 13 with ≥12 months; potential registrational trial design under development.
FDA cleared IND for ADI-212 in mCRPC; Phase 1 enrollment expected to start in 4Q 2026.
Announced progress on differentiated in vivo CAR-T platform; first in vivo candidate targeted to enter clinic in 2H 2027.

title: Adicet Bio says prula-cel last patient visit complete; topline data due Sept 2026, ADI-212 IND cleared
